svg.title: Recurring tickets: work that comes back on a schedule — SoftTrack web design mockup (#264)
svg.desc: Work that repeats is created by hand each time, and none of the eight automation triggers is a date. A schedule creates a ticket every day, week, month, quarter or year, or only once the previous one is done, with its type, assignee, labels, epic and due date set, and lands it in the active sprint or the backlog.
